en.topic_title: Crunch culture and tight timelines blamed for 15 construction site deaths this year
en.topic_summary:
Construction sector representatives have blamed the industry’s crunch culture for the 15 fatal worksite accidents recorded in Hong Kong since the beginning of this year.



Construction workers in Hong Kong. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP.
